The open workspaces: each binding's configuration, backend and lineage, the convergence holding it, if any (with the drift block of an up that asked for drift detection), and its open drift notices: objects the engine saw change outside Turf between convergences, each with its class, changed attribute paths (never values) and source, most severe first, with the coverage and the call that continues (`next`). When this server declares a provider environment (--provider-env), provider_env names the variables a convergence started now would send the engine for its provider plugins, and the declared ones unset here (names only, never values).
